# Retaken at toolkit HEAD fe6b7d90 -- A1+A2 ON *and* the SBND cathode kink veto
# ON by default.  The pr/20 Part II baseline (pr20-sbnd-b0-baseline.txt) is
# STALE for Part I by construction: it was captured at a02c96b3, before both
# SBND behaviour changes.
#
# Binary: local/lib/libWireCellClus.so md5 d72afc9ff8e9f90e97e00adf87bc942a
#         (Aug  2 07:02, newer than every clus source; tracked tree clean).
#
# Repro:
#   cd wcp-porting-img/sbnd/sbnd_xin
#   TAG=pi0base ENTRIES="164 185 191 249 263 314 316 366 454 496 809 850 851 \
#     852 853 854 855 856 857 858" ./run_full1k_nusel.sh 1000 6
#   PR_JOBS=8 ./run_pr_chain_batch.sh work-mcp1kall-pi0base work-pi0base-pr data <the 20 event ids>
#   python3 ../../abtest/hash_archive.py <product>   # first field only
#
# Two arms, because the two halves of the chain answer different questions:
#   nusel arm  work-mcp1kall-pi0base : mabc-all-apa.zip + pctree-evt<ID>.tar.gz
#              (the CLUSTERING products -- what P1/P2 can move) and its own
#              mabc-pr.zip from the nusel pipeline (stops at tagger_check_fc).
#   PR arm     work-pi0base-pr       : mabc-pr.zip + pctree-pr-evt<ID>.tar.gz
#              from the production 13-stage PR pipeline -- the arm P3/P4 move,
#              and the only one that instantiates tagger_check_neutrino.
#
# NOTE the nusel arm's 20 mabc-pr.zip hashes are IDENTICAL to
# pr20-sbnd-b0-baseline.txt line for line, including evt 169824.  That is not a
# failed flip: the nusel pipeline never instantiates tagger_check_neutrino, so
# B0 cannot act there.  Only the PR arm below sees B0.
#
# columns: <event> <product> <sha256 of member contents>
